name: ELISA assay run
description: Sandwich ELISA on 96-well plate. Synthetic Phase-2 fixture; mirrors the Workflow Task API shape, not a real tenant.

steps.name: Coat plate
steps.description: Add capture antibody (100 µL per well, 2 µg/mL). Incubate overnight at 4°C.

steps.name: Wash plate (3×)
steps.description: Wash 3× with PBS-T using the plate washer.

steps.name: Block
steps.description: Add 200 µL 1% BSA-PBS per well. Incubate for 60 minutes at room temperature.

steps.name: Add samples
steps.description: Pipette samples in duplicate, 100 µL per well.

steps.name: Sample incubation
steps.description: Incubate for 90 minutes at room temperature with gentle shaking.
